question: How does a 10% loss floor differ from a 10% buffer when the index falls by 12%?
answer: With a 10% floor, your loss is limited to 10% of the annuity contract value. With a 10% buffer, the insurer absorbs the first 10 percentage points of the index loss, so you lose 2%. These examples are before any contract adjustments, such as surrender charges.
